text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, a kind of mathematical rule. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can guess whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct. Good training data usually leads to better accuracy.
